turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Sharma of Jaipur city?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is Sharma. Who is calling?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am Rohan from the International Shipping Hub. Your overseas parcel is currently stuck at the customs office.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Overseas parcel? I am not expecting any package from outside.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, it is a registered shipment containing documents. The customs officer has flagged it for a missing clearance fee.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I don't understand. Why would I have documents from outside?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It could be from a relative, but if you don't settle the nine thousand five hundred rupees fine now, the police will be notified for illegal import.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Police? This is very stressful, I cannot pay such a big amount suddenly.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Listen, to avoid legal trouble, just send the money via UPI or buy an Amazon gift card and tell me the code.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Gift card for customs? Does the government take gift cards?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is the fast-track process for senior citizens. Please hurry or I cannot stop the case filing.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Let me call my son first and ask him.
